name: Quay route planner
design: Very lean older female with pale ivory spotted hide, narrow wrinkled alien face, long fine four mandibles, grey thin dreadlocks in low tail. Long soft charcoal robes with asymmetrical navy hip wrap, narrow bronze-edged diagonal shoulder sash and small map case. Holds a shallow circular astrogation plate against left forearm and a stylus in right hand at waist, calm careful posture.
